sessions.phase_label: Power-board requirements review and project initiation
Main, sensor, and LED board specification
Modular-board layout completion and production-file preparation
JLCPCB order setup and component sourcing
Manufactured-sample inspection and initial power debugging

requirements.title: Battery Safety and Thermal Protection
requirements.definition: Provide the battery-side protection and temperature-sensing provisions needed for safe charging and operation.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers electrical battery protection and NTC sensing; battery connector type, pinout, and placement are tracked separately.

requirements.title: Battery Connector Interface
requirements.definition: Provide a battery connector with a compatible type, pin count, pinout, and accessible physical placement.
requirements.boundary_note: Connector compatibility and pinout form one interface mechanism; enclosure clearance is represented here only when it directly determines connector usability.

requirements.title: GPIO-Switched 5V Sensor Rail
requirements.definition: Generate the 5V sensor rail with the MT3608 and keep it off by default until explicitly enabled by the ESP32.
requirements.boundary_note: Includes boost-enable GPIO assignment and the default-off pull-down because they jointly control one switched rail; 3.3V regulation is independent.

requirements.title: AXP2101 Battery and USB Power Path
requirements.definition: Use the AXP2101 power path so the device can run from battery or USB and can operate while charging the battery.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers source selection and charge-while-operating behavior; DCDC1 output regulation and transient stability are independently testable.

requirements.title: Stable DCDC1 3.3V Regulation
requirements.definition: Provide a stable effective 3.3V system rail from AXP2101 DCDC1 under boot, flash, WiFi, and other expected load transients.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the DCDC1 voltage target, regulation accuracy, and collapse trajectory; USB data enumeration and general AXP source selection remain separate.

requirements.title: Standalone USB 3.3V Supply
requirements.definition: Allow the modular main board to power its full 3.3V rail, including attached sensors, from USB when the power board is absent.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the modular main-board LDO and OR-ing fallback, not the later AXP2101 DCDC behavior on the integrated board.

requirements.title: 3.3V and 5V Rail Current Monitoring
requirements.definition: Measure total downstream current on the 3.3V and 5V rails using an appropriate monitoring mechanism.
requirements.boundary_note: The monitoring provider may change from INA219 to INA3221 or AXP2101, but both rails belong to one telemetry mechanism.

requirements.title: Panel-Mounted Power Control
requirements.definition: Expose AXP2101 PWRON to a panel-mounted momentary button for device on/off control.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers only the dedicated PWRON control; ordinary GPIO buttons, reset, and BOOT controls are separate.

requirements.title: Battery Charge Status Output
requirements.definition: Expose battery-charge status through the selected LED or external charge-LED connection.
requirements.boundary_note: Tracks the independently changing charge-status mechanism, including removal and later restoration of a dedicated output.

requirements.title: AXP2101 Thermal-Pad Assembly
requirements.definition: Design and manufacture the AXP2101 exposed-pad connection so it provides reliable grounding, heat transfer, and reflow yield.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers exposed-pad vias, paste aperture, and moisture-sensitive assembly concerns rather than functional DCDC regulation.

requirements.title: High-Current Power Path Capacity
requirements.definition: Route VBUS, battery, 5V, and other high-current paths without thin bottlenecks and with adequate copper pours and stitching vias.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a current-carrying layout constraint distinct from voltage regulation and general board dimensions.

requirements.title: Sourceable USB-C Connector
requirements.definition: Use a standard, readily sourceable USB-C connector that exposes the required USB data lines.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers connector part selection and availability; USB protocol behavior and ESD wiring can fail independently.

requirements.title: Native USB Enumeration and Programming
requirements.definition: Route native ESP32-S3 USB D+ and D- correctly so the board enumerates and can be flashed in normal and download modes.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns end-to-end USB data operation; the protective U3 circuit is separate because USB can work after bypassing it.

requirements.title: Correct USB ESD Protection
requirements.definition: Protect USB data lines with a correctly wired ESD device whose VBUS and GND pins remain separate and whose data channels pass through correctly.
requirements.boundary_note: Separate from native USB operation because bypassing U3 restored USB while removing the required protection.

requirements.title: ESP32-S3 Module and Full Pin Breakout
requirements.definition: Use the ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 and expose its available pins through a compact through-hole breakout for reuse and debugging.
requirements.boundary_note: Module choice, full pin access, and breakout pitch define one reusable MCU platform; signal-to-GPIO assignments evolve separately.

requirements.title: Valid ESP32-S3 GPIO Assignment
requirements.definition: Assign peripheral signals only to exposed and suitable ESP32-S3 GPIOs while avoiding unavailable or problematic boot-strapping pins.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers pin suitability and reassignment across peripherals; individual peripheral electrical behavior remains with its own Requirement.

requirements.title: I2C Pull-Ups and Signal Conditioning
requirements.definition: Provide correctly located I2C pull-ups and optional series damping appropriate for the specified cable lengths and bus speed.
requirements.boundary_note: Pull-up value, location, and series damping are attributes of one bus-electrical mechanism rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Active-Low Panel Button and Switch Inputs
requirements.definition: Wire panel buttons and the slide switch as active-low GPIO inputs using 3.3V pull-ups and contacts that short to ground when activated.
requirements.boundary_note: Groups buttons 3/4 and the slide switch because they share one active-low circuit pattern and one common correction trajectory.

requirements.title: PIR and Touch Input Biasing
requirements.definition: Bias PIR and touch-sensor inputs low when disconnected while allowing their active-high push-pull outputs to drive the GPIOs.
requirements.boundary_note: Kept separate from active-low mechanical buttons because the sensor inputs correctly retain pull-downs while the button inputs required pull-ups.

requirements.title: ESP32 BOOT and Reset Circuit
requirements.definition: Provide the on-board BOOT control, external reset connection, and suitable EN/BOOT capacitor values for reliable programming and reset.
requirements.boundary_note: BOOT/reset circuitry is independently testable from ordinary panel GPIO inputs and PWRON control.

requirements.title: Modular Board Power and Signal Interface
requirements.definition: Connect the modular power, main, and sensor boards with matching, serviceable power and signal connectors and consistent pinouts.
requirements.boundary_note: Power/signal split, matching pin order, and chained distribution are attributes of one modular interface; per-sensor output ports are separate.

requirements.title: Sensor Board Module Interfaces
requirements.definition: Provide the specified power, I2C, UART, display, spare-bus, and module-specific connectors on the sensor board.
requirements.boundary_note: Connector inventory and pinouts form the sensor-board interface mechanism; SPS30 mode selection has its own acceptance behavior.

requirements.title: SPS30 I2C Mode Selection
requirements.definition: Hardwire the SPS30 SEL input to ground so the sensor reliably operates in I2C rather than UART mode.
requirements.boundary_note: This mode-select behavior can fail independently even when the SPS30 connector itself is present.

requirements.title: Sensor Logic-Level Compatibility
requirements.definition: Connect current 3.3V-compatible sensor logic directly and avoid reserving unnecessary on-board level-shifter circuitry.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the independently removable sensor level-shifter provision, not the addressable-LED data-level circuit.

requirements.title: Connector Pin Labeling
requirements.definition: Place clear and correct connector pin markings on the PCB so battery, power, and signal cables can be wired safely.
requirements.boundary_note: Label correctness is independently reviewable from the underlying electrical connector pinout.

requirements.title: Addressable LED Power and Data Logic
requirements.definition: Power addressable LEDs at the selected voltage, provide compatible ESP32 data levels, and eliminate standby draw when required.
requirements.boundary_note: Supply voltage, level shifting, and rail switching are tightly coupled parts of one LED electrical interface; physical LED-board layout is separate.

requirements.title: Eight-LED Indicator Board
requirements.definition: Provide a small board carrying eight addressable RGBW LEDs with the selected package and matching power/data connector pinout.
requirements.boundary_note: LED count, package, spacing, and board pinout are attributes of one independently delivered LED-board mechanism.

requirements.title: E-Paper Backlight Control
requirements.definition: Drive an external e-paper backlight with PWM brightness control, boot-safe power switching, decoupling, and 5V/3.3V fallback provisions.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the backlight driver and output interface; ambient-light sensing is independently addable.

requirements.title: Ambient-Light Sensor Interface
requirements.definition: Provide an additional I2C connector for an ambient-light sensor used to control display backlight behavior.
requirements.boundary_note: The sensor connector can be added or removed independently from the backlight switching circuit.

requirements.title: Power Board Mechanical Layout
requirements.definition: Lay out the modular power board compactly with the required mounting holes, layer stack, USB edge position, and accessible connectors.
requirements.boundary_note: Physical dimensions, holes, layers, and connector placement evolve together for this board; electrical connector pinouts remain separate.

requirements.title: Main Board Mechanical Layout
requirements.definition: Fit the modular main-board components and individual connectors into a routable board with accessible cable orientation and ESP32 edge placement.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the main board's size and placement trajectory, which differs from the sensor and power boards.

requirements.title: Sensor Board Mechanical Layout
requirements.definition: Arrange the sensor-board connectors for accessible top-side cabling while fitting and routing the design on the selected layer count.
requirements.boundary_note: Sensor-board fit and connector orientation have their own implementation trajectory and are not merged with the main-board layout.

requirements.title: Integrated Board Mechanical Layout
requirements.definition: Lay out the integrated PCB for enclosure use with accessible connectors, USB and battery on suitable edges, grouped display connections, and antenna clearance.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers only physical placement and enclosure access for the integrated board; the decision to use one board is architectural.

requirements.title: Sourceable and Cost-Conscious Components
requirements.definition: Select components and connectors that are continuously sourceable and, where practical, avoid unnecessary JLCPCB extended-part fees.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a cross-cutting component-selection constraint; BOM completeness and order-account setup are separate deliverables.

requirements.title: Assembly-Ready BOM
requirements.definition: Deliver a complete and correct BOM with manufacturer part numbers, DNP handling, package information, and board-specific contents.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns BOM correctness and completeness; Gerbers, drill data, and positions files are independent production artifacts.

requirements.title: PCB Production File Package
requirements.definition: Deliver the Gerbers, plated and non-plated drill files, pick-and-place data, BOM, and related exports needed to manufacture each board.
requirements.boundary_note: The export package is independently deliverable from the editable KiCad source and BOM semantic correctness.

requirements.title: Portable KiCad Project
requirements.definition: Provide an editable KiCad project with included libraries, relative paths, compatible variables, and required 3D models so it opens across machines.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers editable-source portability and model references, not manufacturing exports or board electrical behavior.

requirements.title: Manufacturer Order Setup Assistance
requirements.definition: Configure the boards and parts in the manufacturing account, review component availability and orientation, and prepare the order for client confirmation.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an explicitly requested operational deliverable, not generic project administration or testing.

requirements.title: Assembly Component Orientation
requirements.definition: Ensure polarized and pin-identified components have correct pick-and-place rotations and can be confirmed before production.
requirements.boundary_note: Orientation correctness is independently observable from whether the order was added to a cart or the BOM was complete.

requirements.title: Cost-Optimized Integrated Single Board
requirements.definition: Replace the modular power, main, and sensor-board arrangement with one lower-cost board while retaining required functionality and reducing connectors.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the one-board architectural decision and cost objective; individual power, USB, sensor, and layout behaviors remain independent Requirements.

requirements.title: Future Direct-Sensor Integration Board
requirements.definition: Create a later board variant that mounts selected sensor chips directly instead of connecting external sensor modules through JST connectors.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a separately proposed future board and should not be merged into the current integrated-board lifecycle.

requirements.title: Device Enclosure
requirements.definition: Provide an enclosure that securely holds the boards and battery, supports display and lighting openings, permits airflow, and remains easy to assemble.
requirements.boundary_note: The enclosure is an independently discussed future deliverable rather than an attribute of any PCB layout Requirement.

unresolved_candidates.description: The temporary VMID/VSYS trace-cut and DNP-capacitor contingency may be a separate serviceability Requirement or merely an abandoned implementation option within AXP power-path design.

VRTC, VBACKUP, and PWROK access may warrant separate Requirements, but the supplied history mixes optional future RTC retention, debug access, and an implementation that may not match the client's final NC decision.
The enclosure is clearly specified but appears to be discussed as a possible separate project; contractual inclusion in the current project cannot be established from the messages.
The direct-sensor board is a future separately paid project and may be outside the final retained scope even though its intended behavior is independently identifiable.
